summary: Official Ipatinga municipal SEGEO and SETI pages establish a local geoprocessing system and property-cadastre custodian. Public parcel geometry and a safe native parcel identity were not verified, so runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Brazilian Portuguese discovery queries, exact text, outcomes, and actual result URLs are recorded in city-8019-ipatinga.json.
requestOutcomes: TLS-verified GET retrieved the official SEGEO page, SETI page, municipal maps/data downloads page, organogram, relevant cadastral legislation page, and the public online tax-service page. The municipal pages load dynamic content through first-party JavaScript/AJAX, but inspection of the current HTML/script references did not reveal a public parcel GIS service URL or schema. The tax page exposed CAPTCHA and property/account lookup fields and was not submitted or probed.
